title: MMCircuitEval: A Comprehensive Multimodal Circuit-Focused Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs
problem: Existing LLM evaluation benchmarks lack comprehensive coverage of EDA tasks; multimodal LLMs need assessment across diverse circuit design stages and abilities.
motivation: MLLMs show promise for EDA automation, but comprehensive evaluation across design stages from front-end to back-end is missing.
method: MMCircuitEval assembles 3,614 question-answer pairs combining text and circuit diagrams, drawn from textbooks, datasheets, and technical documentation reviewed by experts. These pairs cover both digital and analog circuits across the entire circuit design process—from basic knowledge questions through design specifications, front-end work (initial design), and back-end work (physical layout). Each question is categorized by design stage, circuit type, the skill it tests, and difficulty level.
key_novelty: This is the first comprehensive benchmark combining text and circuit diagrams for electronic circuit design, spanning all design stages and both digital and analog circuits.
limitations: Benchmarks LLM knowledge but does not assess practical EDA tool integration.
primary_theme: Multimodal benchmark for EDA task evaluation
